text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by the Radio Latvia on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The sixth meeting of the Council of the Baltic Sea states started in Riga, with foreign ministers and diplomats of 11 countries participating.

- The Baltic sea region is not a priority for Russia, highlighted by the fact that Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov did not attend the Baltic sea states council meeting, Latvian foreign minister Valdis Birkavs said.
- Latvia and Norway today sign a visa-free travel agreement, which will come into effect on August 1.
